fieldDescription: auto: AI voices from the companion app when it is running, otherwise the system voice. companion: only the companion app. system: only the operating system voice. off: never speak. The companion app comes with the optional Read Aloud: AI Voices mod, which has its own page here.

quotes: text in quotation marks is read in the character's voice (male or female), everything else by the narrator. character: all text is read in the voice of the person you are talking to. single: the narrator reads everything. speech: only what characters say (text in quotation marks) is read, in their voice; the narrator is silent.

Only with 'Who reads what' set to speech: where narration between two quotes is skipped, wait this many milliseconds before the next quote, so separate lines don't run together. One pause however much narration was skipped. 0: no pause.

After you save these settings, play a short sample with the system voice. changed: only the voices you changed (and all of them when speed, volume or 'Who reads what' changed). all: every voice, each time. off: no samples.
Read each new block of dialog text as it appears, without pressing the speaker button.
After the text, read the list of options you can pick.
Stop speaking when you leave the dialog.
Show the speaker button in dialogs. The hotkey works either way.
endOfText: just after the last paragraph. corner: bottom right corner of the text area.
Reads the latest text, or stops if already speaking. Default F8.

fieldName: Start the companion app when needed
fieldDescription: Start the companion app in the background when the game needs it, trying again at most once a minute if it isn't running. Only after you have set it up once (companion/start.cmd in the Read Aloud: AI Voices mod).
